title: The subtlety of optimal paternalism in a population with bounded rationality
title_zh: 有限理性群体中最优家长式干预的微妙性
title_primary: 有限理性群体中最优家长式干预的微妙性
title_secondary: The subtlety of optimal paternalism in a population with bounded rationality
authors: Charles F. Manski, Eytan Sheshinski
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the subtlety of optimal paternalism when a utilitarian planner has the power to design a discrete choice set for a heterogeneous population with bounded rationality. We first consider the planning problem in abstraction. We show that the policy that most effectively constrains or influences choices depends multiplicatively on the preferences of the population and the choice probabilities conditional on preferences that measure the suboptimality of behavior. We then study two settings in which the planner may mandate an action or decentralize decision making. One setting supposes that individuals measure utility with additive random error and maximize mismeasured rather than actual utility. Then optimal planning requires knowledge of the distribution of measurement errors. The other setting studies binary treatment choice when the planner can mandate a treatment conditional on publicly observed personal covariates or can enable individuals to choose their own treatments conditional on private information. Here we focus on situations where bounded rationality takes the form of deviations between subjective and objective probabilities of uncertain outcomes. To illustrate, we consider clinical decision making in medicine. In toto, our cautionary analysis shows that determination of optimal policy requires the planner to possess extensive knowledge that is rarely available. We warn that research in behavioral public economics should avoid overoptimistic claims regarding the nature of optimal paternalistic policies. We argue that credible study of utilitarian planning should consider not only the population but also the planner to be boundedly rational.

title: Central bank digital currency and corporate risk-taking: evidence from China
title_zh: 央行数字货币与企业风险承担：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 央行数字货币与企业风险承担：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Central bank digital currency and corporate risk-taking: evidence from China
authors: Zhidong Tan, Qiandi Ma, Lina Yan, Yuan-Teng Hsu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the effect of central bank digital currency (CBDC) on corporate risk-taking. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2017 to 2023, we exploit the pilot rollout of China’s CBDC(e-CNY) as a quasi-natural experiment and implement a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) design. The results show that CBDC significantly increases corporate risk-taking, and this finding remains robust to a range of tests. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs) and firms with higher institutional ownership. Mechanism analyses suggest that CBDC operates by alleviating agency problems and financing constraints, which enhances firms’ risk-taking propensity and capacity. The study further documents that the increased corporate risk-taking associated with CBDC is associated with higher firm value and total factor productivity ( TFP ). These findings extend the literature on the economic consequences of CBDC and the determinants of corporate risk-taking, while offering useful implications for its broader promotion and application.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行数字货币（CBDC）对企业风险承担的影响。利用2017至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，我们将中国CBDC（数字人民币）的试点推广视为准自然实验，并采用多期双重差分（DID）设计。结果显示，CBDC显著提升了企业风险承担水平，且这一发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。异质性分析表明，该效应在非国有企业（non-SOEs）及机构持股比例较高的企业中更为显著。机制分析揭示，CBDC通过缓解代理问题和融资约束发挥作用，从而增强企业的风险承担意愿与能力。研究进一步指出，与CBDC相关的企业风险承担增加与企业价值及全要素生产率（TFP）的提升相关联。这些发现拓展了关于CBDC经济后果及企业风险承担决定因素的文献，同时为其更广泛的推广与应用提供了有益启示。

title: National evidence on glucose-lowering medication use for diabetes from 62 low- and middle-income countries
title_zh: 62个低收入和中等收入国家糖尿病降糖药物使用的国家证据
title_primary: 62个低收入和中等收入国家糖尿病降糖药物使用的国家证据
title_secondary: National evidence on glucose-lowering medication use for diabetes from 62 low- and middle-income countries
authors: Teufel, Felix, Roddewig, Pia, Marcus, Maja E., Theilmann, Michaela, Andall-Brereton, Glennis 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Given rising diabetes prevalence globally, access to diabetes treatments is gaining urgency. Yet, it remains unknown which glucose-lowering medication types people with diabetes across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) use. In this cross-sectional analysis, we pooled nationally representative data of 223, 283 adults aged ≥25 years in 62 LMICs from 2009 to 2019. We found that 51.9% [95%-CI: 49.6%, 54.2%] of 21, 715 individuals with diabetes were undiag-nosed. Among individuals with diagnosed diabetes, 18.6% [95%-CI: 14.5%, 23.4%] reported using no glucose-lowering medication, 57.3% [95%-CI: 53.1%, 61.4%] only used oral medication, 19.5% [95%-CI: 17.6%, 21.5%] used oral med-ication and insulin, and 4.7% [95%-CI: 3.9%, 5.6%] used insulin alone. In low-income countries, fewer individuals with diabetes were diagnosed and treated than in middle-income countries. Yet, among individuals who did get diag-nosed, insulin use was two-thirds higher in low-income countries (38.9% [95%-CI: 31.6%, 46.7%]) compared to middle-income countries (23.2%; 95%-CI: 21.0%, 25.5%]). This ﬁnding could suggest a need for earlier diagnosis and treatment initiation. Our results can inform national and regional drug procurement efforts across LMICs.
abstract_zh: 鉴于全球糖尿病患病率持续上升，糖尿病治疗的可及性日益紧迫。然而，目前尚不清楚低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的糖尿病患者使用哪些类型的降糖药物。在本横断面分析中，我们汇总了2009年至2019年间来自62个低收入和中等收入国家、年龄≥25岁的223,283名成年人的全国代表性数据。我们发现，在21,715名糖尿病患者中，有51.9%[95%置信区间：49.6%，54.2%]未被诊断。在已确诊的糖尿病患者中，18.6%[95%置信区间：14.5%，23.4%]报告未使用任何降糖药物，57.3%[95%置信区间：53.1%，61.4%]仅使用口服药物，19.5%[95%置信区间：17.6%，21.5%]同时使用口服药物和胰岛素，4.7%[95%置信区间：3.9%，5.6%]仅使用胰岛素。在低收入国家，糖尿病患者的诊断率和治疗率均低于中等收入国家。然而，在已确诊的患者中，低收入国家的胰岛素使用率（38.9%[95%置信区间：31.6%，46.7%]）比中等收入国家（23.2%；95%置信区间：21.0%，25.5%]）高出三分之二。这一发现可能表明需要更早的诊断和治疗启动。我们的研究结果可为低收入和中等收入国家的国家和区域药物采购工作提供参考。

title: Dual-track in the family: How spousal state employment fuels entrepreneurship
title_zh: 家庭中的双轨制：配偶体制内就业如何助推创业
title_primary: 家庭中的双轨制：配偶体制内就业如何助推创业

authors: Wenchao Li, Yifan Lin, Junjian Yi, Haochen Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: China’s rapid growth alongside extensive state ownership challenges theories of state-sector inefficiency. This paper identifies a novel micro-level channel: “dual-track in the family,” whereby one spouse’s stable state job enables the other to pursue private entrepreneurship. Using a triple-difference design that exploits the 1993 market reform, we find that spouses of state employees were 9.8 percentage points more likely to become entrepreneurs after the reform. Mechanism evidence suggests that spousal state employment may promote entrepreneurship by insuring the family against risk. The findings reveal how a gradualist, dual-track transition can succeed partly by leveraging state-sector stability to underpin private-sector dynamism.
abstract_zh: 中国经济的快速增长与大规模国有制并存，对国有部门低效率的传统理论构成挑战。本文识别出一个新颖的微观层面渠道：“家庭双轨制”，即一方稳定的国有部门工作使另一方得以投身私营创业。利用1993年市场化改革作为准自然实验，采用三重差分设计，我们发现改革后，国有部门员工的配偶成为企业家的概率高出9.8个百分点。机制证据表明，配偶的国有部门就业可能通过为家庭提供风险保障来促进创业。研究结果揭示了渐进式双轨转型何以部分成功，其关键在于利用国有部门的稳定性支撑私营部门的活力。

abstract: 农业生产的季节性深刻影响着劳动力配置与经济结构转型，但这一关键因素在既有研究和政策框架中尚未得到充分重视。本文构建两部门、两时期理论模型，分析农闲劳动力流动对非农扩张的影响，并基于清代《刑科题本》构建18—19世纪中国府级面板数据进行实证检验。研究发现：农业季节性总体上促进区域经济发展，机制在于农闲期释放的劳动力以佣工形式进入手工业和服务业，推动劳动力跨部门配置。进一步分析表明，较高的政府治理能力、较强的宗族组织以及良好的地方文教环境，有助于降低劳动力匹配与市场交易成本，促进季节性劳动力转化为生产性就业。空间异质性显示，在非农能力不足的地区，农业季节性可能导致失业增加，而在长江流域及南方地区，农闲劳动力更容易转化为非农就业。时间异质性表明，随着经济结构演进，农业季节性边际作用减弱。本文从农业时间结构视角补充了二元经济与内卷化讨论，也为理解乡村振兴中统筹农闲就业承接、农忙用工保障与县域产业发展关系提供了历史经验。

title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
title_zh: 扩大加班覆盖范围对劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: 扩大加班覆盖范围对劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
authors: Simon Quach
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the labor market effects of overtime coverage in the United States, where salaried workers are covered for overtime if their base pay falls below a legislated salary threshold. Using an event-study design with administrative payroll data and state-level threshold changes from 2014-2021, I find evidence against conventional models of overtime. Contrary to the historical intent of policymakers, firms do not increase employment by substituting more workers for fewer hours. However, contrary to compensating differential models, firms also do not offset the costs of overtime by lowering workers' base pays. Instead, employers raised salaries above the threshold to keep workers exempt from overtime, indicating that monitoring and adjusting workers' hours is costly for firms. Taken together, these results suggest that expanding overtime coverage increases workers' earnings without negatively impacting employment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国加班覆盖政策对劳动力市场的影响。在该政策下，若受薪工人的基本工资低于法定工资门槛，则其享有加班费保障。基于2014-2021年行政工资数据与州级门槛变动，采用事件研究法设计，本文发现了与传统加班理论相悖的证据。与政策制定者的历史意图相反，企业并未通过以更多工人替代更少工时的方式增加就业；同时，与补偿性工资差异模型相反，企业也未通过降低工人基本工资来抵消加班成本。相反，雇主将工资提高至门槛以上以维持工人免于加班覆盖，这表明监控和调整工人工时对企业而言成本高昂。综合来看，这些结果表明扩大加班覆盖范围能提高工人收入，且不会对就业产生负面影响。

title: Voluntary environmental regulation and carbon information disclosure: evidence from the green factory certification in China
title_zh: 自愿性环境规制与碳信息披露：来自中国绿色工厂认证的证据
title_primary: 自愿性环境规制与碳信息披露：来自中国绿色工厂认证的证据
title_secondary: Voluntary environmental regulation and carbon information disclosure: evidence from the green factory certification in China
authors: Ping Zhang, Rui Xiang, Biao Shi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines whether voluntary environmental regulations enhance corporate carbon information disclosure (CID), an underexplored issue in carbon governance. Based on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2023, we use green factory certification as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences approach. Data were obtained from the CSMAR and CNRDS databases. The final sample consists of 4,966 firms, yielding 40,953 firm-year observations. Results show that certification significantly improves firms’ CID. Mechanism tests reveal three channels: stronger managerial and organizational green awareness, increased investor and media attention, and promoted green investment and innovation. Heterogeneity tests indicate the effect is stronger for firms in non-high-carbon industries, non-key-polluting firms, those in regions with cash incentives and those in areas with weaker low-carbon regulation. Certified firms that receive environmental penalties do not improve CID, verifying the effectiveness of post-certification dynamic monitoring. Furthermore, certification promotes both symbolic and substantive disclosure, reduces greenwashing and cuts real carbon emissions, supporting a ‘talk-and-walk’ governance effect. Certified firms also generate positive spillover effects, motivating industry peers, city peers and downstream supply-chain customers to enhance CID. This study offers causal evidence for voluntary environmental regulation in carbon governance and implications for incentivizing credible carbon disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨自愿性环境规制是否能够提升企业碳信息披露水平，这是碳治理领域中尚未充分探究的问题。基于2010年至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，以绿色工厂认证作为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分法进行分析。数据来源于CSMAR和CNRDS数据库，最终样本包含4,966家企业，共计40,953个公司-年度观测值。结果表明，认证显著提升了企业的碳信息披露水平。机制检验揭示了三条路径：管理层与组织绿色意识的增强、投资者与媒体关注度的提升，以及绿色投资与创新的促进。异质性检验显示，在非高碳行业企业、非重点污染企业、位于现金激励政策地区以及低碳规制较弱地区的企业中，该效应更为显著。获得认证但受到环境处罚的企业并未改善碳信息披露，这验证了认证后动态监管的有效性。此外，认证同时促进了象征性披露与实质性披露，减少了“漂绿”行为，并降低了实际碳排放，支持了“言行一致”的治理效应。获得认证的企业还产生了正向溢出效应，激励同行业企业、同城市企业以及下游供应链客户提升碳信息披露水平。本研究为自愿性环境规制在碳治理中的因果效应提供了证据，并对激励可信碳信息披露具有政策启示。

title: Wealth Inequality and Safe Asset Demand
title_zh: 财富不平等与安全资产需求
title_primary: 财富不平等与安全资产需求
title_secondary: Wealth Inequality and Safe Asset Demand
authors: Xuning Ding, Zhengyang Jiang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how wealth inequality shapes safe-asset demand in heterogeneous-agent economies. Asset bubbles arise when agents face sufficiently high probabilities of falling into extreme poverty. In such cases, assets insulated from idiosyncratic risk become infinitely large relative to agents' wealth ex-post, which makes them infinitely valuable ex-ante. This mechanism is fundamentally different from classic rational bubbles, generates bubbles even under stationary wealth distributions, and requires no aggregate uncertainty or growth. Using this insight, we revisit the pricing of aggregate assets in standard heterogeneous-agent economies, and show that prior analyses may be incomplete due to overlooked possibility of transversality condition violation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究财富不平等如何塑造异质性主体经济体中的安全资产需求。当主体面临足够高的极端贫困概率时，资产泡沫便会形成。在此情形下，免受异质性风险影响的资产相对于主体事后财富而言变得无限大，从而使其事前价值趋于无穷。这一机制与经典理性泡沫存在本质差异，即便在稳态财富分布下也能产生泡沫，且无需依赖总体不确定性或经济增长。基于这一发现，我们重新审视标准异质性主体经济体中总体资产的定价问题，并指出由于横截条件可能被违反这一被忽视的可能性，先前的分析可能存在不完整性。

title: DP21640 Monetary and Fiscal Policy when People Have Finite Lives
title_zh: 人在有限生命期限内的货币与财政政策
title_primary: 人在有限生命期限内的货币与财政政策
title_secondary: DP21640 Monetary and Fiscal Policy when People Have Finite Lives
authors: Roger Farmer, Pawel Zabczyk
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper incorporates realistic demographic structure into macroeconomic policy analysis by examining an overlapping generations model calibrated to match U.S. income data over the lifecycle. We provide explicit conditions for the existence of multiple dynamically efficient steady-state equilibria with positive debt levels for empirically relevant calibrations. Unlike in representative agent frameworks, indeterminacy can arise in our model under passive monetary and active fiscal policy. More surprisingly, one degree of indeterminacy remains even when both policies are active. Following fundamental shocks, the model generates highly persistent swings in real interest rates consistent with evidence on long-horizon trends. Our tractable approach bridges theoretical models relying on infinite horizons and homogeneous agents with finite-lived heterogeneous consumers that populate actual economies.
abstract_zh: 本文将现实的人口结构纳入宏观经济政策分析，通过构建一个校准至匹配美国生命周期收入数据的世代交叠模型展开研究。我们给出了在经验相关校准下，存在多个具有正债务水平的动态有效稳态均衡的显式条件。与代表性主体框架不同，在被动货币政策和主动财政政策组合下，我们的模型可能产生不确定性。更令人意外的是，即使两种政策均为主动型，仍存在一阶不确定性。在基础冲击发生后，该模型能生成与实际长期趋势证据高度一致的、高度持续的实际利率波动。我们提出的易处理分析框架，将依赖无限期界与同质主体的理论模型，与构成现实经济的有限生命异质性消费者群体相衔接。

title: Tariffs and Capital Flows
title_primary: 关税与资本流动
authors: Sugata Marjit, Gouranga Das, Mausumi Kar, Ujjyini Kar, Lei Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analytically explores how FDI are affected by Tariffs as President Trump has imposed retaliatory tariffs on countries which have trade surplus with US and declared this as a strategy to attract tariff jumping FDI into US.. Our motivational empirical results show that with greater trade-openness, historically, greater trade deficit led to larger FDI into US. So correcting deficits artificially by a tariff would actually adversely impact FDI flows into US. We then show that:(i) based on the long-run Heckscher-Ohlin [HOS] model where capital is mobile and FDI is an avenue whereby capital outflows could occur based on the rate of return, for US type economy, return to capital will fall as Wage will rise via Stolper-Samuelson effects while for exporting trade-surplus economies like China, the result would be opposite as labor-intensive goods are taxed by US tariff. As return to capital rises, capital will outflow from USA; (ii) However, alternatively, in a very short-run scenario where inter-country capital flows are not so fast (immobile) and not-easy for moving out but within-country perfectly mobile, the outcomes could be very different. With sector-specific capital in the exporting trade-surplus economy, return to capital might fall in both places and the result can go either way. Historically free trade created the trade deficit but return to capital in USA was higher and attracted FDI. Thus, tariff escalation might go either way, without having much to do with controlling trade surplus or deficit.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论层面探讨了关税如何影响外国直接投资（FDI），背景是特朗普总统对与美国存在贸易顺差的国家加征报复性关税，并宣称此举旨在吸引“关税规避型”FDI流入美国。我们的实证动机结果显示，历史上，随着贸易开放度提高，更大的贸易逆差反而带来了更多流入美国的FDI。因此，通过关税人为纠正贸易逆差，实际上会对流入美国的FDI产生负面影响。我们进一步表明：（i）基于长期赫克歇尔-俄林（HOS）模型（其中资本可流动，FDI是资本根据回报率外流的渠道之一），对于美国这类经济体，由于斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森效应，工资上升将导致资本回报率下降；而对于中国等出口导向型顺差经济体，由于美国关税对劳动密集型商品征税，结果则相反。随着资本回报率上升，资本将从美国流出；（ii）然而，在另一种极短期情景下，当国家间资本流动速度较慢（即资本不可快速流动且不易转移），但国内资本完全流动时，结果可能截然不同。在出口顺差经济体中，若资本具有部门特定性，两国的资本回报率可能均下降，最终结果具有不确定性。历史上，自由贸易导致了贸易逆差，但美国资本回报率更高，从而吸引了FDI。因此，关税升级可能产生双向影响，与调控贸易顺差或逆差并无太大关联。

title: A Targeting Bonus for More Effective Agri‐Environmental Policy
title_zh: 更有效的农业环境政策的定向奖励
title_primary: 更有效的农业环境政策的定向奖励
title_secondary: A Targeting Bonus for More Effective Agri‐Environmental Policy
authors: Matteo Zavalloni, Katherine Simpson, Nick Hanley
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Despite significant policy interventions and conservation initiatives, incentives for the conservation of biodiversity have been criticised for being ecologically ineffective and economically inefficient. This paper examines a novel approach to improve the ecological and economic performance of such incentives. Specifically, we analyse the ecological and economic effectiveness of a targeting bonus which establishes a two‐part subsidy for changes to land management when the ecological benefits of such changes vary spatially. Using a spatially explicit mathematical programming model applied to an empirical case study in the UK, we show that a targeting bonus has the potential to enhance efficiency, with the magnitude of gains depending on the strength of the spatial correlation between opportunity costs and ecological benefits, as well as the size of the budget and the definition of the targeting zone. We find that the targeting bonus offers major advantages when the most ecologically beneficial land parcels are positively correlated with highest opportunity costs for farmers; and that the additional benefits of the targeting bonus relative to a no‐bonus subsidy scheme eventually decline as the share of the bonus is increased.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有显著的政策干预和保护举措，生物多样性保护激励措施仍因生态效果不佳和经济效率低下而受到批评。本文研究了一种提升此类激励措施生态与经济绩效的新方法。具体而言，我们分析了定向奖励金的生态与经济有效性——当土地管理变更的生态效益存在空间差异时，该机制通过建立两部分补贴来应对这种变化。通过将空间显式数学规划模型应用于英国实证案例研究，我们发现定向奖励金具有提升效率的潜力，其收益幅度取决于机会成本与生态效益之间的空间相关性强度、预算规模以及定向区域的界定方式。研究结果表明：当生态效益最高的地块与农民机会成本最高的地块呈正相关时，定向奖励金具有显著优势；随着奖励金占比提高，相较于无奖励金补贴方案，定向奖励金的额外收益最终会递减。

title: Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns
title_zh: 基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益
title_primary: 基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益
title_secondary: Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns
authors: Deshui Yu, Difang Huang, Ximing Yin
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that the cyclical component of market-based short-term interest rate uncertainty (SRU) is a robust predictor of aggregate stock market returns, whereas the slow-moving trend component obscures this predictability. In real-time out-of-sample forecasting, the cyclical component of SRU achieves an R 2 of up to 14.22%, significantly outperforming the historical average and a broad set of standard financial and macroeconomic predictors. This predictive performance translates into substantial economic value for mean-variance investors. Mechanistically, the cyclical component captures transient uncertainty shocks that are strongly linked to interest rates, real economic activity, and investor sentiment. A present-value decomposition reveals that the predictive power of cyclical component operates primarily through the cash-flow channel rather than the discount-rate channel.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，基于市场的短期利率不确定性（SRU）的周期成分是股票市场总体回报的稳健预测因子，而其缓慢变动的趋势成分则掩盖了这一可预测性。在实时样本外预测中，SRU的周期成分实现了高达14.22%的R²，显著优于历史平均值及一系列标准金融和宏观经济预测指标。这种预测能力转化为均值-方差投资者可观的经济价值。从机制上看，周期成分捕捉了与利率、实际经济活动及投资者情绪紧密相关的暂时性不确定性冲击。现值分解显示，周期成分的预测力主要通过现金流渠道而非贴现率渠道发挥作用。

title: Audit centralization and audit quality: Evidence from Chinese cities
title_zh: 审计集权与审计质量：来自中国城市的证据
title_primary: 审计集权与审计质量：来自中国城市的证据
title_secondary: Audit centralization and audit quality: Evidence from Chinese cities
authors: Jian Chu, Raymond Fisman, Yongxiang Wang, Maoliang Ye
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Audit design invokes a tradeoff between a monitor’s local knowledge and their independence from influence. We study this tradeoff in the context of a pilot program in six Chinese provinces in 2016, in which provincial governments were given control over budgeting and personnel decisions for city audits. Using a difference-in-differences framework we show that, compared to non-pilot provinces, centralization increases detection of suspicious expenditures by over 50%. These improvements occur also in cities with auditors appointed pre-2016, suggesting that stronger incentives and greater resources rather than auditor selection explain the improvements. Consistent with this interpretation, we find that financial (but not human) resources devoted to city audits increase with centralization. Further results show that centralization’s benefits are strongest in provinces that centralized audit office financing as part of the reform – particularly in poorer cities – suggesting a role for resources in improved performance.
abstract_zh: 审计设计涉及监督者的地方知识与他们免受影响之间的权衡。我们在2016年六个中国省份的试点项目中研究了这一权衡，其中省级政府获得了对城市审计预算和人事决策的控制权。利用双重差分框架，我们显示，与非试点省份相比，集中化使得可疑支出的检出率提高了超过50%。这些改进也出现在2016年前任命审计师的城市中，表明是更强的激励和更多的资源，而非审计师的选择，解释了这些改进。与这一解释一致，我们发现，用于城市审计的财务（而非人力）资源随集中化而增加。进一步的结果显示，集中化的益处最显著于那些作为改革一部分而集中了审计办公室融资的省份——尤其是在较贫困的城市——这表明资源在绩效改进中发挥了作用。
